notes: Captured blank, after JavaScript rendered. No personal data.
A German-language form on a German ATS — the primary user's actual case, and the first fixture that tests the German aliases against a real page rather than labels we wrote ourselves.
First and last name have visually-hidden (sr-only) labels and rely on placeholders; the inputs themselves are visible, so they must still be filled.
Labels carry a trailing '(erforderlich)' inside an sr-only span, so the matched text is 'e mail erforderlich' rather than 'e mail'.

'Gehaltsvorstellung' is required here and originally had no schema field, so it was left blank. Adding logistics.salaryExpectation raised this fixture from 5/6 to 6/6 — the change that motivated the field.
notQuestionsWhy: Neither is an essay question. Salary is a short factual field the user must answer; availability is answered from the profile.
